none: PAS NLM-D2ED6A: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Valentinian
contea di ritrovamento: Nottinghamshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of House of Valentinian (364-378), Victory left issue, Reece period 19. Obverse description: Bust probably diademed draped and cuirassed right. Reverse description: Victory advancing left. Reverse inscription: [SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE]. Diameter: 15.3mm, Weight: 1.36gms, die axis: 6
